title.narrative: Number of regional HIV/AIDS units (UDLS) reporting annually on at least 75% of M&E indicators

comment.narrative: All 12 UDLS are functional and reporting annually and therefore the target of this indicator was achieved. In addition, theprojectsignificantly contributed to building the capacity of the coordinating national authority (SEP/CNLS) both at the managerialand technical levels.

title.narrative: Percent of population reached through HIV/AIDS IEC/BCC radio/television programs

comment.narrative: Source: 2011/2012 DHS. Although the value of this indicator increased significantly from baseline value, it didn't achieve thetarget set for the end of the project.

title.narrative: Number of orphans and vulnerable children (OVC) receiving a package of services (education, health, and psychosocial support)

comment.narrative: The assessment of this indicator at last ISR was wrong. This should be the cumulative number of OVC supported by the project sinceits beginning. The target for this indicator has therefore been achieved.

title.narrative: Percentage of pregnant women living with HIV who received antiretrovirals to reduce the risk of mother to child transmission

comment.narrative: Source: SEP/CNLS report. Contrary to what was reported last time, this indicator increased to satisfactorily compared to baselinevalue. The difference between this value (64%) and the last one is that for the latter the percentage was calculated using thenumberof pregnant women tested instead of using the total number of positive pregnant women expected in a given year as thedenominator.

title.narrative: Number of PLWHA benefiting from ARV treatment and monitoring at the frequency defined by the National Guidelines

comment.narrative: This target for this indicator has been exceeded. There are 16,083 adults and among them 10,785 women (67%) and 5298 men(33%)Inaddition there are 1206 children: 633 boys (52%) and 573 girls (48%)

title.narrative: Number of blood units used for transfusion screened for HIV, HpB ,HpC and syphilis

comment.narrative: Source: CNTS and SEP/CNLS reports. The target of this indicator has been achieved since all blood units are now systematicallyscreened for the 4 diseases.

title.narrative: Percentage of men and women aged 15 to 49 a. reporting knowledge that HIV can be transmitted from mother to child during pregnancy,and b. identifying condoms as a prevention method

comment.narrative: Data from the 2011/12 DHS preliminary results. The target for women on the use of condoms were reached . All the values increasedover time for both men and women

title.narrative: Percentage of men and women aged 15-49 having used a condom duringtheir last sexual contact with a casual partner

comment.narrative: The value of this indicator increased among women from 21% to 38.7% essentially reaching the 40% target. It decreased for men(33.3%) from the value at baseline (42.8%).

title.narrative: Number of private enterprises that offer HIV/AIDS services to workers

comment.narrative: The target for this indicator has been exceeded.

title.narrative: Number of Community projects approved and started

comment.narrative: Source: SEP/CNLS report (September 2011). The target for this indicator was not achieved. This was partially due to the projectrefocusing more on most-at-risk populations rather than funding community-based projects targeting the general population.

From the 2011 sentinel surveillance among pregnant women, the prevalence of HIV among women aged 15-19 years was 2.1% (which isnotstatistically different from the 1.96% prevalence rate among the same group of young women in 2006 Sentinel surveillance data).The1.4% at baseline in 2004 as derived from a household survey and is comparable to the 2009 household survey which showed aprevalence rate of 1.9% among young women aged 15-19 years. The objective of the project to keep this indicator at its baselinelevel was therefore achieved.
